name: branding-off-white-palette-cards-over-dimmed-menswear-store-photo
title: Three swatch cards (Portage Blue, Errigal white, Cool Gray) with RGB, CMYK and hex over a dark menswear store photo
whatItIs: A navy-tinted photo of a menswear store with a light uppercase headline about an urban-edge and minimalist-luxury palette and three staggered swatch cards each with a name, three spec rows (RGB, CMYK, Hex) and the brand name.
whatItMeans: Refined and grounded; placing swatches over the real store links colour to context.
techniques: Stagger swatch cards over a real-world photo.
List three colour specs on each card.

vocabulary.definition: A card showing a colour with its specs.
Swatches placed over a real environment.
A photo overlaid with a colour.
